fetch.notes: Confirmed live: bbox product query returns real JSON (26,397 total matches for this test bbox, e.g. 3DHP FileGDB products). Sibling endpoint /api/v1/datasets lists the full dataset catalog fronted by this API (confirmed 2026-08-11): NED/3DEP DEM tiers (1m, 1/3 arc-sec, 1 arc-sec, Alaska IFSAR), 3DEP LiDAR Point Cloud (LPC) and OPR/IFSAR DEM, 3D Hydrography Program, NHD, WBD, US Topo, NAIP, GNIS, and small-scale datasets.
The National Map Downloader — confirmed live (HTTP 200); AOI + layer-picker UI over the same product catalog.
